ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally located contiguous black pigment region extending from the notch into the lower-inner lobes; high-frequency speckling at the transition to white regions; isolated black pixel clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped indentation at the central axis; vertex clearly defined against water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations along the entire visible trailing edge; increased amplitude of jaggedness at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex curve on the upper boundary of both lobes, terminating in acute points at the lateral edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular high-intensity pixels localized on the distal tips of both lobes and along the upper edge of the right lobe, contrasting with the primary pigment.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned high-intensity linear streaks visible against the low-intensity pigmented area of the inner-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small-scale V-shaped and U-shaped notches along the trailing edge topography that deviate from a smooth geometric curve.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced feathered appearance of the pigment boundary between the central black and peripheral white regions.
